health.title: Websitestatus
health.intro: Daily operational checks with a recorded result and a notification to every active administrator.
health.schedule: Schedule once a day. Every completed inspection notifies active administrators.
health.last_failed: The latest inspection did not finish. Inspect the scheduler run history.
health.stale: No recent completed inspection is available. Check the cron configuration.
health.notification_ok: Site health inspection completed: everything is OK.
health.notification_attention: Site health inspection completed: something needs attention.

advice.database: Check the database connection and server availability.
advice.cache: Check cache writes and the configured cache service; a fallback may be in use.
advice.storage: Check storage permissions and available space.
advice.uploads: Check upload directory permissions and available space.
advice.disk: Check free space: at least 256 MiB and 5% of the volume are recommended.
advice.runtime: Check cURL, GD, Sodium and ZIP or Phar support.
advice.scheduler: Check recent cleanup and feed runs, their errors and cron configuration.
advice.updates: Inspect the update recovery page and maintenance state before reopening the site.
advice.http: Check homepage availability and speed. A redirect requires correcting the configured site URL; a timeout or connection error is a failed measurement.

http.limits: TTFB: warning above {warning} ms, critical above {critical} ms.

errors.configuration: A valid site URL is missing from configuration.
errors.response_limit: The response exceeded the size limit; the transfer is incomplete.

http.total_limits: Total: warning above {warning} ms, critical above {critical} ms.

scheduler.stale: The last successful run is too old.
scheduler.unknown: This older report has no details. Run a new inspection.
